svg.aria-label: Two nodes claim units through the mailbox. Both list units/ to skip the claimed ones, then both try put_if_absent on units/000003-1 at the same moment, each with its own learner ID. The store creates it for node 1 and answers node 2 that it exists. Node 1 reads the object back, finds its own ID and loads the unit. Node 2 moves on to the next unit in its order, 000003-2, creates it, reads back its own ID and loads it.
svg.text: When the store accepts both writes at once, the read-back names one owner and the node it does not name moves on.
The read-back does not make a non-atomic store safe: exclusive claims need an atomic put_if_absent.
